title: Bulk-Line Relief on Northgate+ Business Returns
content:
**Bulk purchases.** A return from a line bought in quantity receives relief under the Business return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships on the reversal, according to the units bought on the returned line as its Northgate Store and Online Orders line record shows:

| Units bought on the returned line | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.1 |
| 2 to fewer than 4 | 0.05 |
| a single unit | nothing |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical lines).** A line of 4 units adds 0.1 and a line of 3 units adds 0.05; a line of 2 units adds 0.05 and a line of 1 unit adds nothing.
